name: Shell_Load
description: looks up ShellMain / ShellWindowProc in the front-end DLL with GetProcAddress

name: Fatal_Message
description: message box with the game title; default text "not enough memory"

name: Opponents_Load
description: reads multicar.def and the NVCL*.vcf opponent vehicle files

name: Objectives_LoadText
description: the mission's objective text file (.npt) for the Notepad

name: Notepad_Init
description: the Notepad device context and font; loads cnote.wav

name: Font_AddResource
description: installs ee_____.ttf through a .fot font resource

name: Cd_FindByLabel
description: finds the CD drive by volume label (I76_CD)

name: Files_Init
description: start-up: the CD by label, the xyzzy probe, then i76.zix (fatal without it)

description: reads a ZIX's root lines (disc label lines, DIR:, CD<n>:) up to the separator

name: Zix_CompareName
